name: Parks on the Air (POTA)
notes: Parks on the Air — activation and hunter logging, always on. Rules: https://docs.pota.app/docs/rules.html (fetched 2026-08-25): 'A successful activation requires a minimum of 10 QSOs from a park in the designated list within a single UTC day (Zulu day)'; required log fields are the station callsign or operator, call, date, time, band and mode; 'A separate log must be submitted for each park of the multi-park simultaneous activation' — Export for POTA writes one file per park, named per https://docs.pota.app/docs/activator_reference/submitting_logs.html (fetched 2026-08-25). Dupes count once per call, band, mode, UTC day and own-park set, and never block logging. OPEN QUESTION: whether POTA's checker counts duplicate contacts toward the ten — the rules are silent, so the validity meter counts the stricter unique form (docs/research/pota/SOURCES.md, 'POTA rules for the dedicated mode'). Scoring: POTA has none; every QSO is zero points by design.
